description: Pause one heartbeat: it is no longer reported late, pings to its ping_url are accepted but ignored, and its open incident closes without an alert. Use it when the job is stopped on purpose, such as a runner taken out of service; resume_heartbeat undoes it, while delete_heartbeat removes the heartbeat for good. Maintenance windows do not cover heartbeats. Requires a key with the write scope. Pausing a paused heartbeat changes nothing. Returns the heartbeat.

heartbeat_id.description: The heartbeat's uuid from list_heartbeats. An id that is not a heartbeat of this organization, or a deleted one, is a 404.

name: pause_heartbeat

state.description: Known values: PENDING, UP, DOWN, PAUSED.

title: Pause a heartbeat monitor
